label: common nouns naming periods of time: day, night, morning, noon, evening, month, year
note: dinam, rātriḥ, prātaḥ, madhyāhnaḥ, sāyam, māsaḥ and saṁvatsaraḥ are all taught, and `ṛtuḥ` ('a season') is added in chapter 61. WEEKDAY AND MONTH NAMES AND THE SIX SEASON NAMES ARE STILL ABSENT, which is why SA-A1-T-02 records the calendar as incomplete: naming a period is not the same demand as locating one, and the generic word for a season is not the six names.
